evaluation: Phase 6 Dynamic Pricing & Price Elasticity Engine

business_constraints.profit_policy: Profit optimization was not executed because unit cost/margin data is absent in observed data. Revenue maximization applied.

observational.identification_assumption: None (Naive correlation). Subject to omitted variable and selection bias.
observational.caveat: Reflects cross-sectional price-demand correlation. Does not isolate causal price changes.

adjusted.identification_assumption: Conditional unconfoundedness given customer history, seasonality, category, and promotion assignment.
adjusted.caveat: Identified conditional on observed covariates. Does not account for unobserved product quality or cross-product brand substitution.

causal_dml.identification_assumption: Double Machine Learning Neyman-orthogonal residualization assuming unconfoundedness given W.
causal_dml.caveat: Isolates pricing variation orthogonal to customer history, seasonality, and promotional assignment.
